info.title: Bulwark API
info.description: REST API for the Bulwark DNS filtering resolver.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the question name.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: Match a specific client (IP or name).

200.description: Admin account created; session cookie set

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: How many entries to include in each top-N list.

AddListResponse.description: Result of creating a filter list.

id.description: The id assigned to the new list.

rule.description:
A single rule line to append to the custom rules, e.g. `@@||example.com^`
or `||ads.example.com^`. Used by the query-log "allow/block" actions.

AddRuleResponse.description: Result of appending a single custom rule.

added.description: `false` when the rule already existed (the append was a no-op).

password_hash.description: Argon2 password hash; `None` until the admin sets a password (setup flow).

max_ttl_secs.description: Clamp upper bound for TTLs (seconds); 0 means "no upper clamp".

optimistic_max_age_secs.description:
Optimistic caching (serve-stale): the maximum number of seconds **past
expiry** that a stale entry may be served immediately while a fresh
resolve runs in the background. `0` disables serve-stale entirely; any
value `> 0` enables it and bounds how stale an answer can be (entries are
never served unbounded).

CheckResponse.description: The filtering verdict for a domain probe.

list_name.description:
The filter list responsible, present whenever a rule matched
(`Custom rules` for user-written rules).

rule.description: The matching rule text, if any.

filtering_enabled.description: Whether filtering applies to this client.

ids.description: Identifiers: IP addresses or CIDR ranges.

ErrorResponse.description: Error body returned for any non-2xx response.

rule_count.description: Cached metadata (updated by the server; persisted for the UI).

url.description: Remote URL to fetch; if absent the list is managed purely in the UI.

custom_rules.description: User-authored custom rules (one rule per line).

FilteringSettings.description:
The subset of filtering settings editable from the Settings page (the lists
and custom rules have their own endpoints).

FiltersResponse.description: The filtering overview: lists, custom rules, and current mode.

LogEntryView.description:
A query-log entry, flattened for the UI, plus the resolved filter-list name.

The internal `QueryAction` is an internally-tagged enum; here it is splayed
into a plain `action` discriminator string and a few optional fields so the
generated TypeScript type is a single flat row (rather than a discriminated
union) that the query-log table can consume directly.

allowlisted.description: True if an `@@` exception allowed an otherwise-blocked query.

list_id.description: Filter list id responsible (blocked/rewritten queries only).

list_name.description:
Friendly name of the filter list responsible (absent unless the query was
blocked or rewritten by a known list; id 0 is the user's custom rules).

content.description: Optional inline content (when no URL is given).

anonymize.description: Whether to anonymize client IPs (drop last octet / suffix).

persist.description: Persist the query log to disk so it survives restarts.

retention_days.description:
How many days of query log to retain on disk (independent of `stats`).
0 keeps only the in-memory `size` window.

size.description: Number of recent entries kept in memory for fast browsing.

total.description: Total entries currently held (before paging, after filtering).

SeriesPointDto.description: A point in the hourly time series.

dns_bind.description: Addresses to serve plain DNS on (UDP + TCP).

http_bind.description: Address to serve the web UI + API on.

ServerUpdateResponse.description: Response for server-config updates: bind changes only take effect on restart.

persist.description: Persist statistics to disk so they survive restarts.

retention_days.description:
How many days of time-bucketed statistics history to keep (independent of
the query-log retention).

StatsResponse.description: A statistics snapshot plus live cache counters.

StatusResponse.description: Setup/auth status and basic server info.

authed.description: Whether the current request carries a valid session.

setup_needed.description: Whether the initial admin account still needs to be created.

TestResult.description: The result of a one-off upstream connectivity test.

TopEntryDto.description: A name + count pair for top-N lists.

TransportKindDto.description: The wire protocol used to reach an upstream.

bootstrap.description: Plain-DNS bootstrap servers for resolving DoT/DoH/DoQ hostnames.

probe_interval_secs.description: Interval between background latency probes (seconds); 0 disables probing.

servers.description:
Freeform upstream list: one spec per line. Lines starting with `#` are
comments and blank lines are ignored — both are preserved verbatim so
you can annotate and toggle entries by commenting them out. e.g.
`https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query`, `tls://one.one.one.one`.
